notes.title: Devlog - Light and Shadow Update
notes.content:
September Devlog
Summer is over, now everyone is back from Holidays. I was working on Dungeon Run relentlessly. I had a long list of things to add to the next release and I want to keep you in the loop. So, I will keep updating you about my progress with regular devlogs.

Light and Shadow Update
One group of them added dynamic lighting, full day light cycle, with lights and shadow, pitch dark dungeons and post processing to create a much better atmosphere for the run. I also implemented an awesome AI pathfinding for the flying mobs like the wasps. they will respect the terrain and hunt you down mercilessly. I have doubled the variation of the randomly generated tile sets which creates more interesting terrain. I have added one new dungeon area and 3 new monsters. A lot of bug fixes and performance enchantments. Many many Achievements are also included.

Story and Bosses Update
The other group of things I'm working on are the four new player characters which I'd shown you before and a witty story with fully voiced cutscenes and many more bosses to defeat. New monsters and new buildings and backgrounds.

Status
I was originally planning to release both of the above updates as one giant update, but I am getting close to finishing the Light and Shadow update. While the Story and Boss Update needs more time. I don't see why I would not release the Light and Shadow Update earlier. So you can expect it as soon as it ready.

Happy Gaming!
